protocol.status: Prespecified execution ablation only; no winning policy or new service recommendation selected
protocol.purpose: Test whether suitability and risk diagnostics of an annually restored static target can be inherited by less frequent trading. Compare paired actual holdings and costs before designing a forecast gate.

data_scope.prior_exposure: V1 final 121--180 already seen; no fresh blind claim. Full-development targets are in-sample; outer-fold targets are learned solely from their 96 training scenarios.

targets.full: Three target weights from alpha_10__risk_only full-development menu, fixed throughout each path.
targets.fold: The three target weights from each already recorded alpha_10__risk_only 96-scenario fit; no use of its 24 held-out outcomes in target choice.
targets.same_target_pairing: Each alternative executes the same fitted target from the same initial all-bill 100 and same market path; no policy-specific retargeting or reassignment.

policies.annual_restore: Mandatory initial purchase; restore target at the start of each subsequent year, charging actual transfers once.
policies.initial_then_hold: Mandatory initial purchase; thereafter keep actual asset units with no transfers for all remaining years.

accounting.timing: Known holdings through t-1; trade before realized year-t return. No terminal liquidation, contributions or withdrawals.
accounting.inflation: Deflate full executed wealth path; retain pre-allocation initial 100 and running peak.

reports.target_level: All three full and fold target roles at H=5,6,15,25,30: annualized log growth, median/P10 real CAGR, median/P90 MDD, CVaR90 MDD, volatility, fees, actual moved and decision/trade fraction; include annual baseline replication checks.
reports.client_frozen_assignment: For each given client, retain its original full/fold product or Review; at own H,L report exact breach count, denominator, expected excess and other metrics. Review remains null, coverage retained; no invented adviser outcome.
reports.paired: Compare alternative minus annual at individual scenario-target level before aggregate summaries. Expected log-growth difference uses each client H. Descriptive whole-scenario bootstrap of paired mean differences is optional and must be labeled empirical, not future-risk confidence.
reports.cost_units: Mean cumulative nominal fees are an accounting amount. Also report annual fee/V and cumulative moved/V ratios without adding across unlike denominators; do not describe nominal fee sums as a return percentage.
reports.drift: Record max end-of-year total-variation target drift and terminal weights; report endpoint quantities separately from pre-trade drift.

protocol.no_selection: Do not select or retune target/menu, alpha, gate, drift band, safety trigger, response delay or forecasting model using this ablation. No band thresholds or cost gates are implicitly introduced. No dynamic-target claim.
protocol.inference: OOF is an internal paired comparison of a target-training procedure, not a policy-wide binomial certificate; overlapping training fits and reused development paths remain. New execution suitability must later be fitted/screened as part of a complete service.
protocol.provenance: Record source/input/output hashes and start/end source stability; only guarded development loader/cache.

summary_metadata.median_method: numpy.median; mean of the two middle values for even sample sizes
summary_metadata.cvar90_definition: average of the worst 10% probability mass, including fractional boundary atoms
summary_metadata.risk_event: MDD - L > 1e-12; smaller differences treated as numerical equality

pairing: initial_then_hold minus annual_restore at the individual original scenario/frozen target, then summarized; quantiles of differences are not differences of quantiles
null_referrals: Frozen Review is retained with null outcomes and counted in coverage, without invented adviser returns
cost_units: nominal_fees and nominal_moved are cumulative accounting amounts; moved_to_initial_wealth divides by fixed initial 100 and is not return. fee_fraction and moved_fraction divide each annual amount by its own pre-trade wealth. No terminal liquidation fee.
npz_axes: wealth=(scenario,target,year0..30); annual accounting/drift=(scenario,target,year1..30); end_weights adds final asset axis equity,bond,bill. scenario_ids and targets identify each context.
decision_fraction: target_execution_fraction counts scheduled execute_target calls, even if nothing is moved; trade_fraction counts actual positive transfers. Neither models human review frequency.
drift: max_end_year_tv_drift=max_t .5*sum_i abs(end_weight_t_i-target_i), using annual post-return weights through H; pretrade_tv_drift is stored separately
scope: Prespecified fixed-target execution ablation; full-development is descriptive/in-sample, OOF is paired internal procedure comparison with overlapping training fits; no winner, reassignment, gate, bootstrap confidence or risk certificate selected
